name: LazyTasks – Project & Task Management with Collaboration, Kanban and Gantt Chart
author: LazyCoders LLC

sections.installation:
How to Install LazyTasks

  • Download the Plugin: Navigate to the ‘Plugins’ section in your WordPress dashboard, click ‘Add New’, and search for LazyTasks in the WordPress Plugin Directory.

  • Install the Plugin: Once you find LazyTasks, click the ‘Install Now’ button next to the plugin name. WordPress will automatically download and install the plugin for you.

  • Activate LazyTasks: After installation is complete, you’ll need to activate LazyTasks to start using it. Find the plugin in your installed plugins list and click the ‘Activate’ link.

  • Automatic Onboarding: Once activated, go to the newly available LazyTasks section in your WordPress dashboard, you will be taken through our onboarding process to finish the installation process.

  • Happy Tasking!
sections.faq:
Q: What is LazyTasks?

  • LazyTasks is a project management and collaboration tool designed for WordPress, offering features like task management, kanban boards, Calendar, Gantt charts and more.

Q: Is LazyTasks free to use?

  • YES! The LazyTasks plugin is absolutely free and includes ALL features.

Q: Is there any feature constraint on the free version of the plugin?

  • Absolutely not! It is totally free and the plugin comes with all features with no hidden fee. You can create unlimited projects, users, tasks, and more.

Q: Are there any paid features or add-ons?

  • The core LazyTasks plugin is 100% free. The premium mobile app (iOS and Android) is a paid product with additional features and 24/7 support. Optional add-ons (such as the upcoming Time Tracker and Performance Scorer) may have their own terms, but the core plugin is always free.

Q: Can I access LazyTasks on mobile devices?

  • Yes, LazyTasks offers native apps for both iOS and Android, allowing for seamless mobile access. The mobile app now features full permission parity with the web plugin, in-app commenting, and a dedicated notifications center.

Q: How do roles and permissions work in LazyTasks?

  • LazyTasks has both global and project-scoped permissions. You can create custom roles, assign different roles to the same user across different projects, and use built-in parent-child rules that prevent accidental permission misconfiguration. Task creators and assignees automatically have rights over their own tasks without needing broader permissions. Every permission row has a tooltip explaining what it controls.

Q: Can I import tasks from other tools?

  • Trello and Todoist importers are in active development and coming soon. Once released, you’ll be able to bring over projects, sections, tasks, subtasks, tags, comments, attachments, and priorities in a guided wizard.

Q: Does LazyTasks support team collaboration?

  • Absolutely. LazyTasks supports real-time collaboration with features like comments, @mentions, task followers, activity logs, whiteboard commenting, and notifications across web and mobile.

Q: Does LazyTasks require any external service to run?

  • No. LazyTasks runs entirely on your WordPress site. Your data stays in your WordPress database. Optional integrations (SMTP providers, Google OAuth, Firebase for push notifications) are available but not required.

Q: Are my data and projects secure with LazyTasks?

  • Yes. Data security is a priority for LazyTasks, with robust permission controls and privacy features. You have complete control over your data since it lives on your own WordPress installation.

Q: Can I integrate LazyTasks with other tools?

  • LazyTasks offers various integrations including Google OAuth social login, any SMTP server for email notifications, and WP SMS for SMS notifications. Gmail and Google Calendar integrations are on the roadmap.

Q: Where can I seek help if I encounter issues with LazyTasks?

  • For support, visit the ‘Help’ section within the LazyTasks plugin, reach out through our support page, or join our community.

Q: Can I suggest new features or improvements?

  • Certainly! We highly value community feedback to enhance LazyTasks. Please contact us through our support page, our community forum, or directly via our website.

sections.description:
Comprehensive Task Management, FREE! Minimalist design with powerful features to boost your productivity.

🟧 Description 🟧

⚠️ Notice: We’re constantly improving the plugin based on real user feedback. If you encounter any issues or have a feature suggestion, feel free to share your feedback directly through the feedback form in the plugin. You can also connect with our founder via WhatsApp messaging.

Join our community to share feedback, suggest new features and get help from fellow users as well as the LazyTasks team. Your voice helps shape the future of the plugin — connect with us today.

LazyTasks brings to WordPress an unparalleled task management experience that seamlessly integrates your project workflows into your WordPress environment. Crafted with efficiency in mind, LazyTasks is more than just a plugin; it’s a robust solution that creates the foundation for managing tasks, projects, and teams directly from your WordPress dashboard. Best of all, it comes with native mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms and maintains its commitment to excellence by being entirely free.

🟧 Why Choose LazyTasks? 🟧

📋 Comprehensive Task and Project Management
Create, assign, follow, and comment on tasks with ease. Our user-friendly interface ensures your projects are always on track and accessible.

🪧 Kanban Board
Visually manage your workflow with our intuitive Kanban board. Drag and drop tasks through different stages, from inception to completion.

🖍 Project WhiteBoard
Turn brainstorming into results. Capture ideas, refine with comments, and convert directly into tasks.

🗒 Visualizing Projects
Our task list, kanban board, gantt chart, calendar, and swimlane (upcoming) views give you a multi-angle perspective on your projects, providing enhanced visibility so nothing falls through the cracks.

📊 Per-Project Reports & Insights 🆕
Every project now has a dedicated Report tab with six widgets — KPIs, status and priority breakdowns, section progress, team workload, and overdue tasks — so you can see health at a glance.

🤖 Quick Task Chatbot 🆕
Capture tasks the moment they cross your mind. The Quick Task Chatbot lets you jot down anything quickly, then convert to a proper task when you’re ready.

🎨 Customizable Portal 🆕
Make the portal feel like your own — upload your logo, set a portal title with size and color control, pick a header background color with optional gradient, and toggle show/hide on every branding element.

🔐 Robust Roles and Permission Management
LazyTasks includes robust roles and permission management — create custom roles, assign specific access levels, or update permissions for existing roles anytime. With smart parent-child rules, helpful tooltips on every permission, and built-in ownership for creators and assignees, it’s flexibility and control built right into your workspace.

🧩 Project-Based Roles
Roles are project-specific. Assign different roles to the same user across multiple projects. Gain finer control and manage team access exactly where it’s needed.

⚡️ Enhanced Productivity
Boost your team’s productivity by managing tasks and projects faster than ever before.

📱 Mobile Access
With native iOS and Android apps — now with full permission parity and in-app commenting — manage your tasks on the go. Our mobile applications are designed to keep you connected and productive, no matter where you are.

🆓 Always Free
We believe powerful project management should be accessible to everyone. The LazyTasks WP plugin is completely free, forever!

🟧 Features at a Glance 🟧

👥 Unlimited Users, Projects and Tasks for organized task management
📑 Kanban Boards for workflow visualization
🗂 Gantt Charts with Day, Week, and Month views
🗓 Calendar Integration with drag-and-resize scheduling
🖍 Whiteboard to bridge ideas into actions
📊 Per-project Reports with KPIs, charts, workload, and overdue views
🤖 Quick Task Chatbot for rapid task capture
🔍 Global search across List, Board, and all views
🗃 Section By, Group By, and advanced filters across every view
📦 Archive and unarchive for sections, tasks, and projects
🎨 Customizable portal branding — logo, title, colors, gradient header
🔐 Fine-grained roles & permissions with parent-child rules and tooltips
🧩 Project-based roles — assign different roles to users per project
📧 Email notifications via any SMTP provider (test connection built-in)
🔑 Google OAuth social login
📱 Mobile Apps (iOS & Android) for on-the-go management
🗿 Multiple list views grouped by different options
📤 Task Assignments and Follow-ups for team collaboration
💬 Comments on Tasks (web and mobile) for seamless communication
⚙️ Notification template creation to use internally or integrate with other plugins
🔔 Web and Mobile Push Notifications

🟧 Roadmap 🟧

🚀 Coming Next
➡️ Time Tracker add-on — per-task timers, time logs, and reports
➡️ Performance Scorer add-on — team and individual performance tracking
➡️ Trello import — bring projects with sections, tasks, subtasks, tags, comments, and attachments
➡️ Todoist import — bring tasks with labels, priorities, subtask hierarchy, and notes
➡️ Export to CSV, PDF, and Excel

🗺 On the Roadmap
➡️ White-label mobile app for your organization
➡️ Swim Lane views for advanced task organization
➡️ “Zen Mode” for focused planning and execution
➡️ Gmail integration
➡️ Google Calendar integration
➡️ LinkedIn and Facebook social login

And much more!

🟧 Get Started with LazyTasks 🟧

Transform your WordPress site into a powerful project management hub with LazyTasks. Whether you’re managing a personal blog or running a multi-author site, LazyTasks can cater to all your task management needs, helping you stay organized and focused.

🟧 LazyTasks Mobile App 🟧

Join our community to share feedback, suggest new features and get help from fellow users as well as the LazyTasks team. Your voice helps shape the future of the plugin — connect with us today.

LazyTasks brings to WordPress an unparalleled task management experience that seamlessly integrates your project workflows into your WordPress environment. Crafted with efficiency in mind, LazyTasks is more than just a plugin; it’s a robust solution that creates the foundation for managing tasks, projects, and teams directly from your WordPress dashboard. Best of all, it comes with native mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms and maintains its commitment to excellence by being entirely free.

🟧 Why Choose LazyTasks? 🟧

📋 Comprehensive Task and Project Management
Create, assign, follow, and comment on tasks with ease. Our user-friendly interface ensures your projects are always on track and accessible.

🪧 Kanban Board
Visually manage your workflow with our intuitive Kanban board. Drag and drop tasks through different stages, from inception to completion.

🖍 Project WhiteBoard
Turn brainstorming into results. Capture ideas, refine with comments, and convert directly into tasks.

🗒 Visualizing Projects
Our task list, kanban board, gantt chart, calendar, and swimlane (upcoming) views give you a multi-angle perspective on your projects, providing enhanced visibility so nothing falls through the cracks.

📊 Per-Project Reports & Insights 🆕
Every project now has a dedicated Report tab with six widgets — KPIs, status and priority breakdowns, section progress, team workload, and overdue tasks — so you can see health at a glance.

🤖 Quick Task Chatbot 🆕
Capture tasks the moment they cross your mind. The Quick Task Chatbot lets you jot down anything quickly, then convert to a proper task when you’re ready.

🎨 Customizable Portal 🆕
Make the portal feel like your own — upload your logo, set a portal title with size and color control, pick a header background color with optional gradient, and toggle show/hide on every branding element.

🔐 Robust Roles and Permission Management
LazyTasks includes robust roles and permission management — create custom roles, assign specific access levels, or update permissions for existing roles anytime. With smart parent-child rules, helpful tooltips on every permission, and built-in ownership for creators and assignees, it’s flexibility and control built right into your workspace.

🧩 Project-Based Roles
Roles are project-specific. Assign different roles to the same user across multiple projects. Gain finer control and manage team access exactly where it’s needed.

⚡️ Enhanced Productivity
Boost your team’s productivity by managing tasks and projects faster than ever before.

📱 Mobile Access
With native iOS and Android apps — now with full permission parity and in-app commenting — manage your tasks on the go. Our mobile applications are designed to keep you connected and productive, no matter where you are.

🆓 Always Free
We believe powerful project management should be accessible to everyone. The LazyTasks WP plugin is completely free, forever!
